games.name: HOUR 12 🕛 [ANOMALY]
games.desc:
💤You fell asleep at your desk. It's late. Time to go home. 

⏰HOUR 12 is a first-person anomaly horror game set in an endless 1970s office. 

Every room should look exactly like the last one. If it does, keep walking through the EXIT. If anything is different — turn around and go back through the door you came in.

Every right call moves the clock forward an hour. 
A wrong one sends you back to 1:00. 
Reach 12 and you can clock out.

• 100+ anomalies to discover
• Single player & CO-OP modes. 
• An 'endless' mode unlocks after your first shift.
• Headphones recommended.

Inspired The Exit 8 style anomaly games.

games.name: HOURS
games.desc:
Seize control of time itself to break through waves of foes in this singleplayer hack and slash with roguelite elements.

Features:
- 15 different characters called "Hosts" to play as, such as the Invader, the Witness and the Vestige.
- Mix and match them with 32 unique time powers called "Tempo". Stop time, go through time loops or predict the future. Time itself is yours to command.
- A variety of upgrades with powerful effects unique to each Host that promote various playstyles.
- Fight more than 30 challenging enemies and bosses that will test your skill to the max.
- All returns to nothing when you die. Your actions may be meaningless, but will you push forward and reach the end in spite of that?
- Face off against the most advanced AI on Roblox in endless mode.

Like this game? Share it, tell your friends, spread the word! Or buy Hands of Time, the game's premium gamepass!

games.name: [ICE TRACKS ❄️] Drifting on a Brick 🧱🏎️
games.desc:
A simple world where you race against the clock... on a brick!
Since there are no wheels, no tyres, there is also no traction, but there is a lot of fun!

Controls:
* Throttle: W/Up (keyboard), R2/RT (controller)
* Brake: S/Spacebar/Down (keyboard), L2/LT (controller)
* Steer: A,D/Left,Right (keyboard), Left Thumbstick (controller)
* Left/rear/right view: Z/X/C or J/K/L (keyboard), Right Thumbstick (controller)

Premium players get a bonus of 10% on all Bricklets earned or purchased.
